d:
Pakistan amerika ke qarib hai. amerika-eeran ke bich dushmani hai. aise men pakistan amerika ke qarib rahte hue eeran ke sath kaise rah pata hai aur eeran ke is bharose ke pichhe kya hai?
Pahli khabar men aaj isi ki bat.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
